sanskrit:
अहंकारं बलं दर्पं कामं क्रोधं च संश्रिताः।
मामात्मपरदेहेषु प्रद्विषन्तोऽभ्यसूयकाः।।
caption:
The root cause: Envy. ‘ahaṅkāraṁ balaṁ darpaṁ’ (Bewildered by false ego, strength, pride). ‘kāmaṁ krodhaṁ ca saṁśritāḥ’ (Lust and anger). ‘mām ātma-para-deheṣu pradviṣanto ‘bhyasūyakāḥ’ (They become envious of the Supreme Personality of Godhead, who is situated in their own bodies and in the bodies of others, and blaspheme against the real religion). Why do they hate religion? Because God is the rival. They want the throne. They bully others because they envy the God within them.
